About this home

Enjoy classic Tucson charm with modern comfort in this inviting 3 bedroom, 2 bath home set on a large lot with welcoming curb appeal. Inside, a great open floor plan creates an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances and opens to the living areas, keeping everyone connected while cooking, dining, or relaxing. A stone wall fireplace adds warmth and character, while beamed ceiling details bring architectural charm to the main living space. Step outside to the covered patio, perfect for outdoor dining, morning coffee, or enjoying Tucson's beautiful weather. With its spacious lot, updated kitchen, and distinctive Southwestern-style details, this home offers comfort, personality, and room to enjoy indoor-outdoor living.

About Desert Aire-Loma
Linda
Desert Aire-Loma Linda, located between East 22nd Street and East Broadway Boulevard, is a mid-century and suburban Tucson neighborhood with a desert-grid street plan and mountain-view horizons. The neighborhood’s character concentrates around the Park Place Mall area near E Broadway Blvd and N Wilmot Rd, where storefronts, patios, and steady foot traffic set a commercial cadence. Park Place Mall and the Loft Cinema act as cultural anchors, with Trail Dust Town adding a local, old-Tucson counterpoint. Housing leans toward ranch-style homes and low-slung apartments with carports and block walls. Daily life orbits around retail corridors, pocket parks, and bikeable side streets. The Santa Catalina Mountains frame the north, while broad arterials define the edges.
